snippet.title: CS-VR (Unofficial Counter Strike 1.6 VR) announcement / Quest 3 / Pico 4
snippet.description:
CSVR (Unofficial Port of Counter Strike 1.6) is coming to VR for Meta Quest and Pico 4 / Ultra.

Get Early-Access to in-development builds on our Patreon very soon: https://www.patreon.com/teambeef

CSVR is being built on the latest version of the Xash3D FWGS engine (https://github.com/FWGS/xash3d-fwgs), paired with the multiplatform client developed by Velaron (https://github.com/Velaron/cs16-client/releases)
